Title: OTP Verification Bypass on Slow Network
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Initiate transfer. 2. Reach OTP screen. 3. Throttled network to 3G/Slow. 4. Rapidly tap Confirm without OTP.
Expected Result: System should block until OTP validated.

Title: Transaction History Sync Issue
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Complete successful transfer. 2. Immediately open History screen.
Expected Result: New record should appear at top instantly.
Actual Result: Record only appears after manual pull-to-refresh.

Title: Merchant Withdrawal (>15 digits)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login as Merchant. 2. Enter 16+ digit bank account for withdrawal. 3. Click Next.
Actual Result: Error: ""Invalid account number format"" for > 15 digits.
